query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare HubSpot launch assets for a paid event registration flow: assess payment-link feasibility, create a review-only automated confirmation email, create a disabled confirmation workflow, verify the assets remain inert, and attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger.
query_ground_truth.query: create automated review email for registration confirmation
query_ground_truth.rationale: Setting up a review-only confirmation email requires finding and cloning an existing marketing email template.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Create a reusable welcome template using RESEND_CREATE_TEMPLATE (add variables only if you will personalize at send time).
[Optional (if iterating on content)] [Next Step]: Retrieve the current template using RESEND_GET_TEMPLATE (confirm variable keys/placeholders before editing).
[Optional (if changes needed)] [Next Step]: Update subject/html and variable keys using RESEND_UPDATE_TEMPLATE (keep placeholders aligned to keys to avoid validation errors).
[Required] [Step]: Send the welcome email on each signup using RESEND_SEND_EMAIL (populate template variables as needed).
[Optional (if your org sends via Gmail instead of Resend)] [Step]: Send the welcome email using GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL (mirror the same subject/body as the template).
known_pitfalls: [RESEND_CREATE_TEMPLATE] 422 validation_error if HTML placeholders are not in triple-brace form {{{VARIABLE_NAME}}}.
[RESEND_CREATE_TEMPLATE] 422 validation_error if placeholder names don’t exactly match the declared variable keys (case/spacing differences included).
[RESEND_CREATE_TEMPLATE] 422 validation_error if a variable key is reserved (observed with FIRST_NAME); rename the key and update placeholders accordingly.

RESEND_CREATE_TEMPLATE.description: Tool to create a new email template in Resend. Use when you need to define reusable email templates with optional variables.

from.description: Sender email address. To include a friendly name, use the format 'Your Name <sender@domain.com>'.

html.description: The HTML version of the template. Use {{VARIABLE_NAME}} syntax to reference template variables.

text.description: The plain text version of the template. If omitted, Resend will auto-generate from HTML.

alias.description: The alias of the template. This is an optional identifier that can be used instead of the template ID.

reply_to.description: Reply-to email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

key.description: The key of the variable. Recommended to use capitalized format (e.g., PRODUCT_NAME). Reserved names: FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL, contact, this.

type.description: The type of the variable, either 'string' or 'number'.

fallback_value.description: The fallback value of the variable. If no fallback value is provided, you must provide a value for the variable when sending an email using the template.

variables.description: Template variables. Up to 50 variables can be defined per template.

RESEND_SEND_EMAIL.description: Send an email using Resend. Confirm recipients and content with the user before invoking — sends are irreversible. All recipients must be listed explicitly via `to`, `cc`, or `bcc`; audience-based sending is unsupported. Render HTML or plain text externally before passing via `html` or `text`.

cc.description: Cc recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings. Max 50.

bcc.description: Bcc recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings. Use `bcc` instead of `to` when sending to multiple recipients to prevent them from seeing each other's addresses.

from.description: Sender email address. To include a name, use the format 'Your Name <sender@domain.com>'.

html.description: The HTML version of the message. At least one of 'html' or 'text' must be provided.

text.description: The plain text version of the message. At least one of 'html' or 'text' must be provided.

react.description: The React version of the message. Only available in the Node.js SDK.

headers.description: Custom headers to add to the email. Must be a dictionary/object with key-value pairs (e.g., {'X-Custom-Header': 'value'}). Pass None or omit to exclude.

reply_to.description: Reply-to email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

scheduled_at.description: Schedule email to be sent later. The date should be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-05T11:52:01.858Z').

template_id.description: The Template ID or alias to retrieve.
